title: When the Wardrobe Burns
author: Bram Delacroix
blurb: Orsen Quintana, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
